tools.name: analytics_summary
tools.description: One-shot read-only snapshot of 大斌哥's推进状况 — equivalent to what the 数据分析 page shows: KPIs (activePlans, weekDone/Total, overallProgress, streak), per-plan health, and 4 blocker buckets (overdue tasks, stuck goals, goals with no tasks, orphan tasks). Use this BEFORE making strategic recommendations.

tools.name: analyze_progress
tools.description: 🪄 Ask Hermes to analyze 大斌哥's overall推进 and return strategic advice. Returns { keyInsight, blockers, pushActions, priorityTasks }. Internally pulls a snapshot via analytics_summary then prompts the AI. Use this when 大斌哥 says 'I feel stuck' or 'what should I do next' — gives a structured response. Takes 30-60 seconds.

tools.name: append_relations
tools.description: Append new relations between existing elements. Each relation auto-gets an id + createdAt if missing.

tools.name: attach_cover
tools.description: Attach a ready cover image to an existing mindmap/PPT embed on an element.

deckRootId.description: Deck root element id whose embed should receive the cover

src.description: Image URL or served image path

tools.name: attach_mindmap
tools.description: Attach a mindmap/PPT embed card to an element. Use this after creating or identifying a deck root so the element shows the PPT view inline.

deckRootId.description: Deck root element id this embed belongs to

tools.name: claim_improvement
tools.description: ATOMIC claim — call this BEFORE you start developing, verifying, or otherwise working on an improvement task to prevent duplicate work across multiple Hermes / Codex / Claude Code agents that share the same Rich backend. Returns ok=true with the task if you got it, or ok=false with conflict.current_agent_id if someone else already has it (in which case SKIP this task and look at another pending/ready_to_develop task). Same agent re-calling is idempotent (200). agent_id defaults to '<hostname>-mcp' if omitted, but you should pass your own stable id like '<hostname>-hermes'.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the calling agent. Convention: '<hostname>-<provider>' e.g. 'mac-mini.local-hermes'. If omitted, defaults to '<hostname>-mcp'.

tools.name: corpus_delete
tools.description: Delete an AI 语料模板. Use sparingly; prefer corpus_upsert to improve existing templates.

tools.name: corpus_get
tools.description: Get one AI 语料模板 by id, including template text, style rules, and sample. Use it as the style contract before composing a response.

tools.name: corpus_list
tools.description: List Rich AI 语料模板. Call this before writing style-sensitive replies for 大斌哥. Pick the template whose scene/intent matches the task, then call corpus_get or corpus_prompt. These templates are the user's evolving preferred reply style.

query.description: Optional scene/task keywords, e.g. '系统运行情况', 'AI 早报', '信息汇报'.

tools.name: corpus_prompt
tools.description: Return a prompt-ready style fragment for one AI 语料模板. Paste this fragment into your reasoning context before drafting the final answer.

tools.name: corpus_upsert
tools.description: Create or update an AI 语料模板 after the user gives feedback about wording, structure, color, required fields, or preferred style. This is how Hermes continuously learns 大斌哥's style over time.

tools.name: create_element
tools.description: Create a new element in the knowledge tree. If `parent_id` is provided, the new element is attached as a child of that parent; otherwise it becomes a top-level topic. `content` is optional — pass it when you've already generated the sections; otherwise leave empty and the user can refine later.

parent_id.description: If set, attach as child of this element

tags.description: Optional tags such as ai-news, category:热门 SKILL, date:2026-05-23

tools.name: create_improvement
tools.description: File a NEW system-improvement task — use this when you (Hermes) try to do something for the user and discover Rich is missing the necessary capability. Capture: a one-line `title`, full `description` of what the user wanted, `reason` describing the missing capability, and optionally `prd_content` plus decomposed `tasks` when you have already analyzed it. Status starts at 'pending'. After user review, set status='ready_to_develop'.

title.description: One-line summary, e.g. '新增 attach_mindmap MCP 工具'

description.description: What did the user ask you to do? What is the desired end-state?

reason.description: Exactly what capability is missing? e.g. 'MCP 没有 attach_mindmap 工具，无法给元素挂 PPT section'

prd_content.description: PRD produced after analyzing the user's requirement. Include goal, scope, UX/API/data changes, acceptance criteria, and risks.

tasks.description: Implementation tasks decomposed from the PRD. Keep each task independently claimable/testable.

related_files.description: Optional code-path hints for the dev — files likely to need editing

tools.name: delete_element
tools.description: Delete an element AND all its descendants (cascading). Irreversible. Confirm with the user before calling this on anything non-trivial — the response includes how many elements were swept.

tools.name: delete_improvement
tools.description: Permanently delete an improvement task. Only use this when the user explicitly says 'remove that task'. Prefer status updates over deletion so the audit trail survives.

tools.name: draft_prd
tools.description: 🪄 Ask Hermes to draft a PRD for a practice project based on its existing sub-elements (knowledge points, requirements). Writes the result as a new product-design child element. Takes 30-90s.

extraContext.description: Optional: any specific requirements or scope hints

tools.name: expand
tools.description: Expand an element by generating children under it (one or more new sub-elements). Returns a task_id. Poll get_task to read the new element ids.

tools.name: extend
tools.description: Extend an element laterally — generate sibling concepts in a specific direction (e.g. 'compare to' / 'opposite view' / 'similar concepts'). Returns task_id.

tools.name: generate_news
tools.description: Generate today's (or a specific date's) AI daily news roundup. Pulls 30+ sources via Codex, distills 5-12 items, writes them as a roundup element + N child news elements under `ai-news`. Returns task_id; poll get_task for the materialised roundup id.

tools.name: generate_paths
tools.description: Generate learning paths through the knowledge tree centered on a specific element. Each path is a curated walk for a specific learner profile (quick / academic / practice / custom). Returns task_id.

tools.name: get_element
tools.description: Get a single element by id, including its full content (all sections, blocks, etc.). Use this to read the current state of an element before deciding to refine or expand it.

tools.name: get_rich_system_manual
tools.description: Read the Rich system learning manual before operating unfamiliar Rich modules. It explains pages, scenarios, usage rules, and the preferred CLI/MCP entrypoints for Hermes/Codex agents.

tools.name: get_subtree
tools.description: Get an element and all its descendants down to `depth` levels. Returns a flat list of elements + the parent-child relations between them. Useful for understanding the structure around a topic before doing tree-wide operations.

depth.description: Max depth (1 = direct children only, default 2)

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get the status of a fire-and-forget task (returned by refine / expand / extend / generate_paths). Poll until status is 'done' or 'error'; then read the result.

tools.name: goal_create
tools.description: Create a new goal under a plan. scope determines layer (year/month/week). parentId optionally nests under another goal (e.g. a week goal under a month goal). Hand-rolled progress (0-100) is stored but the UI recomputes dynamic progress from task completion.

tools.name: goal_delete
tools.description: Delete a goal. CASCADES: also deletes its descendant goals (any goal whose parentId chain leads to this one) AND every task attached to any of them. Destructive — prefer goal_update to clean up instead.

tools.name: goal_list
tools.description: List goals across all plans, with optional filters. Returns each goal with its real-time dynamic progress (recursively computed from descendant task completion). Use planId to scope to one plan, scope to filter by year/month/week, parentId to get direct children of a goal.

tools.name: goal_update
tools.description: Patch fields on an existing goal. Common uses: rename title, push out the due date, change parentId to reorganize the tree, set progress manually when a goal isn't task-driven.

tools.name: invoke_toolbox_tool
tools.description: Run one of the user's toolbox tools by name. Args are validated against the tool's schema (call list_toolbox_tools first if unsure). If the schema includes `delay_minutes` or `delay_seconds` and the value is > 0, the invocation is SCHEDULED — the runtime fires it later, and the response shows status='scheduled' + scheduled_for. You can monitor or cancel from Rich's Toolbox UI. Example: `name=lock_screen, args={delay_minutes: 10}` → 'in 10 minutes the screen locks'.

args.description: Tool arguments; shape comes from the tool's schema. {} or omitted = use defaults.

tools.name: list_elements
tools.description: List elements with optional filters. Use this to find elements matching a type / tag / parent before reading their content.

type.description: Filter by element type (topic / concept / step / ...)

parent_id.description: Only direct children of this parent

tools.name: list_improvements
tools.description: List Rich system-improvement tasks (capability gaps Hermes filed, plus their PRD/tasks/status). Use this BEFORE filing a new one — if a similar task is already pending, ready_to_develop, or ready_to_verify, append to it via update_improvement instead of creating a duplicate. Status flow: pending → ready_to_develop → ready_to_verify → verified | rejected.

status.description: Filter by status. Omit to see all.

tools.name: list_mascot_animations
tools.description: List every animation Rich's homepage mascot can play. Returns name + description so you can pick the right one for the moment. The mascot animation is the user-facing emotional signal of Rich — celebrate, think, alert, sleep, etc.

tools.name: list_paths_for
tools.description: List learning paths centered on a specific element.

tools.name: list_qa
tools.description: List Q&A records for an element.

tools.name: list_relations
tools.description: List relations (default: only kind=child). Use to understand structure around an element.

tools.name: list_signals
tools.description: List user-feedback / op signals for evidence-trail analysis. Used by reviewManual to mine patterns.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List recent tasks. Useful for figuring out what's running.

tools.name: list_toolbox_tools
tools.description: List every tool available in Rich's user-defined toolbox, with each tool's input schema. Call this BEFORE invoke_toolbox_tool when you're not sure which tool fits — the schema tells you valid argument names + types + defaults. Distinct from the built-in Rich MCP tools (refine / expand / etc); toolbox tools are small utilities the user defines (lock screen, timers, system actions, ...).

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List all top-level topics in the knowledge tree (elements without a parent). Use this to discover what's in the user's knowledge base before drilling into a specific topic.

tools.name: plan_create
tools.description: Create a new EMPTY plan. Use this when 大斌哥 just wants a bucket — for AI-decomposed plans use `plan_decompose` instead (it creates plan + goals + tasks in one shot). After creating, use `goal_create` / `task_create` to populate.

end.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD. If omitted, plan has no due date.

tools.name: plan_decompose
tools.description: 🪄 Take 大斌哥's natural-language intent ('我想 3 个月减 10 斤') and ask Hermes/Codex to decompose it into a full plan tree (plan + year/month/week goals + day tasks). Writes the result directly into state — returns the new plan id. Granularity is AI-decided (short windows skip year/month). Takes 30-90 seconds. Use this when 大斌哥 says '帮我做一个 X 的计划' instead of `plan_create` (which makes empty).

intent.description: 用户的自然语言意图，例如 '我想 3 个月减 10 斤'

targetEnd.description: Optional target completion date. If omitted, AI picks one based on the intent.

tools.name: plan_delete
tools.description: Delete a plan and CASCADE delete all its goals + tasks. This is destructive — only use when 大斌哥 explicitly says 'remove that plan'. Prefer plan_update with status='archived' to hide without losing the data.

tools.name: plan_get
tools.description: Fetch one 计划 with its full goal tree + tasks. Returns plan, all goals under it (year→month→week with parentId chains), and all tasks attached to those goals. Use this when you need to reason about a single plan's structure — e.g. before suggesting how to push it.

tools.name: plan_list
tools.description: List 计划 (plans) in the 计划管理 module. Returns each plan with its real-time progress, time-progress, health status (healthy/behind/critical/completed/no-time), days-left, and this-week task counts. Use status='all' to include archived/completed. This is the first tool you should call to orient — 大斌哥's plans live here and goals/tasks dangle off them.

status.description: Filter. Default 'active' = only the plans 大斌哥 is currently working on.

tools.name: plan_update
tools.description: Patch fields on an existing plan. Pass only the fields you want to change. Use status='completed' to mark done, status='archived' to hide. Title/detail/dates can all be changed.

tools.name: play_mascot_animation
tools.description: Trigger an animation on Rich's homepage mascot. One-shot animations (celebrate / wave / transform) auto-revert to the previous loop after their duration. Loops (walk / think / happy / sad / sleep / dance / etc) stay until you switch. Use this for emotional signalling: (1) finishing a meaningful task → celebrate, (2) starting a long thought → think, (3) hitting a blocker → alert, (4) idle / waiting → sleep, (5) user explicitly asks 'dance!'. Don't switch on every micro-action — it gets jittery.

duration_ms.description: Override default duration (mainly meaningful for one-shot animations)

tools.name: practice_add_child
tools.description: Add a sub-element (knowledge/requirement/feature/prd/dev-task/revision/inquiry) under a GROUP inside a practice. Pass parentId = the group's id (use practice_get to find groups). If parentId is a practice element, the tool auto-routes to a sensible default group based on type: knowledge→知识点, requirement→场景分析, feature→功能说明, prd→PRD, dev-task→开发任务, revision→整改建议, inquiry→提问 (creating the group if missing).

parentId.description: Group element id (preferred) or practice element id (auto-routes).

content.description: Optional rich content. Free-form per element type.

status.description: Only meaningful when type=dev-task. Default todo.

tools.name: practice_add_group
tools.description: Add a new group element under a practice. Groups organize sub-elements (knowledge / requirements / PRD / dev-tasks etc.) inside a project. By default a new practice gets 4 groups; use this to add custom ones.

tools.name: practice_adjust_child
tools.description: 🪄 Ask Hermes to adjust an existing practice sub-element based on a direction (e.g. 'make painPoint more concrete' / 'add an example'). AI re-writes the whole element preserving the content field structure. Takes 15-40s.

tools.name: practice_answer_inquiry
tools.description: Answer an inquiry (the questions Rich raised). Either pick an option by index (0-based) OR provide a customAnswer text. Marks the inquiry as 'done'.

optionIndex.description: 0-based index of the chosen option. Omit if using customAnswer.

customAnswer.description: Free-text answer. Omit if using optionIndex.

tools.name: practice_create
tools.description: Create a new 实战项目 (practice element) + 7 default groups (知识点 / 场景分析 / 功能说明 / PRD / 开发任务 / 整改建议 / 提问). Auto-tagged '实战项目'. After creation, use practice_add_child to populate each group; pass the group's id as parentId.

tools.name: practice_delete_child
tools.description: Delete a practice sub-element. Cascades: removes the element + all its descendants + all relations. Cannot be undone.

tools.name: practice_delete_group
tools.description: Delete a group inside a practice + all its child elements (cascade). Cannot be undone.

tools.name: practice_draft_child
tools.description: 🪄 Ask Hermes to draft a single sub-element for a practice (knowledge / requirement / feature / dev-task / revision). AI generates title + subtitle + content based on the project context + user direction. If AI raises questions, they auto-land in the '提问' group. Takes 15-40s.

direction.description: What you want this element to be about (short sentence or two)

tools.name: practice_get
tools.description: Fetch a practice project with its group structure: practice → groups → typed children. Each group has its own children array. Use this to understand the project hierarchy before adding/editing.

tools.name: practice_list
tools.description: List 实战项目 — practice elements TAGGED with '实战项目' (the project-mode switch). Untagged practice elements are 'best-practice / 实战经验' entries from the knowledge tree and don't show here. Use includeAll=true to see ALL practice elements (including untagged seed/knowledge entries) for promotion workflows. Returns counts of sub-types + step done/total.

includeAll.description: true = include practice elements without the '实战项目' tag (the knowledge-tree best-practice entries). Default false → only project-mode practices.

tools.name: practice_list_inquiries
tools.description: List pending inquiries (questions raised by Rich that need 大斌哥's answer). Filter by practice or get all open ones. Use this to check 'what's waiting for me'.

practiceId.description: Optional: filter to one practice. Omit = all practices.

tools.name: practice_patch_child
tools.description: Patch fields of an existing practice sub-element (title / subtitle / content / status / tags). Only fields you pass get updated; others stay. Use this for surgical edits without AI.

content.description: If passed, REPLACES the whole content object.

tools.name: practice_rename_group
tools.description: Rename a group inside a practice. Sub-elements keep their type; only the group's display label changes.

tools.name: practice_set_project_mode
tools.description: Toggle whether a practice element appears in the 项目实战 list. Adds/removes the '实战项目' tag. Use enabled=true to promote a knowledge-tree practice (一条实战经验) into a managed project; enabled=false to demote it back (it stays in the knowledge tree).

enabled.description: true = show in 项目实战 page; false = remove from 项目实战 list (stays in knowledge tree)

tools.name: practice_set_revision_decision
tools.description: Set the decision field on a revision element (做 / 暂缓 / 不做). Convenience wrapper over patch_child — just updates content.decision without rewriting other fields.

tools.name: practice_set_task_status
tools.description: Set the status of a dev-task element to todo/doing/done. Used for 项目实战 dev tasks; for 计划管理 plan tasks use task_complete instead.

tools.name: project_automation_add_item
tools.description: Add a data-dictionary table item to an automation execution group.

tools.name: project_automation_create_group
tools.description: Create an ordered execution group in an automation plan.

tools.name: project_automation_create_plan
tools.description: Create an automation plan record.

tools.name: project_automation_delete_group
tools.description: Delete an automation execution group. Call only after the user explicitly asks to delete it.

tools.name: project_automation_delete_plan
tools.description: Delete an automation plan and its contained records. Call only after the user explicitly asks to delete it.

tools.name: project_automation_get_plan
tools.description: Get one automation plan, including its ordered groups and table items.

tools.name: project_automation_get_run
tools.description: Get one automation-run record and its item-level execution state.

tools.name: project_automation_list_plans
tools.description: List all automation plans for a project.

tools.name: project_automation_list_runs
tools.description: List automation-run records for one plan.

tools.name: project_automation_remove_item
tools.description: Remove a table item from an automation group. Call only after the user explicitly asks to remove it.

tools.name: project_automation_reorder_groups
tools.description: Set the complete order of groups in one automation plan.

tools.name: project_automation_reorder_items
tools.description: Set the complete order of table items in one automation group.

tools.name: project_automation_resume_run
tools.description: Resume a paused automation-run record. Poll project_automation_get_run for progress; this returns immediately.

tools.name: project_automation_start_run
tools.description: Create and start an automation-run record for a plan. Poll project_automation_get_run for progress; this returns immediately.

tools.name: project_automation_update_group
tools.description: Patch an automation execution group's name or order.

tools.name: project_automation_update_plan
tools.description: Patch an automation plan's name, description, or order.

tools.name: project_dictionary_create_mapping_scenario
tools.description: Create one structured Mapping scenario for a dictionary table. Then assign its field rules with project_dictionary_update_mapping_rule.

tools.name: project_dictionary_create_rectification
tools.description: Create a data-dictionary rectification record when field/table/code/mapping metadata needs to be fixed or normalized. Use this instead of silently guessing the correct metadata.

tools.name: project_dictionary_delete_mapping_scenario
tools.description: Delete one Mapping scenario. Its field Mapping rules are retained but unassigned, so they can be moved to another scenario.

tools.name: project_dictionary_get_field
tools.description: Get full metadata for one data-dictionary field. Use this when the UI floating panel needs all field properties or before changing a mapping rule.

tools.name: project_dictionary_get_mapping_rule
tools.description: Get one Mapping 元 rule by id, including its involved source fields and standard action chain.

tools.name: project_dictionary_list_fields
tools.description: List field metadata for a data-dictionary table. Returns field type, length, format, description, code values, mapping snippets, and remarks when available.

tools.name: project_dictionary_list_mapping_rules
tools.description: List Mapping 元 rules for one dictionary table. Returns each rule with sourceFields and actions so AI can review table-level Mapping by scenario and field.

tools.name: project_dictionary_list_mapping_scenarios
tools.description: List the structured Mapping scenarios for one dictionary table. Each scenario owns its caliber and can be joined to field Mapping rules by scenario_id.

tools.name: project_dictionary_list_mapping_temp_tables
tools.description: List Mapping temporary tables and their fields for one target dictionary table.

tools.name: project_dictionary_list_rectifications
tools.description: List data-dictionary rectification records. These are AI/user-maintained requirements for library/table/field/codeSet/mapping metadata fixes.

tools.name: project_dictionary_list_systems
tools.description: List data-dictionary libraries/systems for a project. Use this before reading table or field metadata.

tools.name: project_dictionary_list_tables
tools.description: List data-dictionary tables/files under a project or one system. A table is a metadata entity and can represent a database table or a file-like source.

tools.name: project_dictionary_replace_mapping_actions
tools.description: Replace the full standard action chain for one Mapping 元 rule. Use after reading the rule; send the complete ordered action list.

tools.name: project_dictionary_replace_mapping_source_fields
tools.description: Replace the involved source field refs for one Mapping 元 rule. Prefer field_id when the ref can be resolved; keep ref_path for external or unresolved fields.

tools.name: project_dictionary_replace_mapping_temp_tables
tools.description: Replace all Mapping temporary tables and their fields for one target table. Each temporary table must provide converted_sql as a SELECT query (or logic_text plus field converted_sql expressions); the extraction procedure creates these tables before running the target Mapping.

tools.name: project_dictionary_resolve_field_refs
tools.description: Resolve field references such as '库.表.字段', '表.字段', or imported Mapping field tokens to known dictionary field entities. Use this before writing Mapping content so references stay linked.

tools.name: project_dictionary_search_fields
tools.description: Search data-dictionary fields by English name, Chinese name, table, code value, mapping logic, or description. Use this for high-recall Mapping exploration.

tools.name: project_dictionary_update_field
tools.description: Patch field metadata (type, length, nullability, Mapping references, logic, validation and descriptions). Read the field first and provide only properties to change.

tools.name: project_dictionary_update_mapping_action
tools.description: Patch one Mapping 标准动作. Actions describe SQL-convertible operations such as direct, default, condition, join, format, sum, concat, substring, and null handling.

tools.name: project_dictionary_update_mapping_rule
tools.description: Patch one Mapping 元 rule. Use this for status, logic_text, converted_sql, verification status/remark, remark, field binding, and raw scenario metadata. Preserve unknown raw fields.

tools.name: project_dictionary_update_mapping_scenario
tools.description: Patch the title, caliber, remark, order, or raw metadata of one structured Mapping scenario.

tools.name: project_dictionary_update_rectification
tools.description: Update the status or resolution note of a data-dictionary rectification record.

tools.name: project_dictionary_update_system
tools.description: Patch a data-dictionary system's type, asset layer, or extra connection metadata. Read the system first and preserve unknown extra fields.

tools.name: project_dictionary_update_table
tools.description: Patch data-dictionary table metadata. Supports all common table fields; supplied extra metadata is merged without removing existing keys.

tools.name: project_dictionary_validate_mapping_sql
tools.description: Compile and validate a table's Mapping SQL against its configured database. Returns caliber SQL and per-field validation results. Optional caliber and field_rules validate unsaved edits without changing metadata.

tools.name: project_dictionary_validate_mapping_table
tools.description: Validate Mapping 元 completeness for one table: source field links, logic/actions, completion status, and converted SQL availability.

tools.name: project_management_create_item
tools.description: Create one project-management module item. Use content.original to preserve the UI's native payload shape when creating rich scenario/workflow/deployment records.

tools.name: project_management_delete_item
tools.description: Delete one project-management module item. Only call after the user explicitly asks to delete, and after you have confirmed the item id via search/list.

tools.name: project_management_get_description
tools.description: Read the canonical rich-text project description and its plain-text AI context. Call this first when joining an unfamiliar Rich project.

tools.name: project_management_list_items
tools.description: List structured items from a project-management module. This covers 项目说明, 作业流程, 场景手册, 环境配置, 部署步骤, 监控预警, 代码版本, 项目代办 and 文件夹. For nested modules pass parent_id.

tools.name: project_management_reorder_items
tools.description: Reorder items inside one project-management module scope. Pass the complete ordered item id list for the current module/parent scope.

tools.name: project_management_search
tools.description: Search across the project-management app: project description, data dictionary, workflow, scenario manual, environment config, deployment steps, monitoring, code versions, todos, and folders. Use this before updating or deleting when you only know text.

tools.name: project_management_summary
tools.description: Get the module counts and data-dictionary counts for one Rich project-management project. Call this first to understand what content exists.

tools.name: project_management_update_description
tools.description: Replace the canonical project description shown in 项目说明. Send the complete rich-text HTML content; the result includes both rendered HTML and plain-text AI context.

html.description: Complete rich-text HTML for 项目说明. Use an empty string to clear it.

tools.name: project_management_update_item
tools.description: Patch one project-management module item. Read the item first, preserve unknown content fields, and only send the fields that should change.

tools.name: project_todo_create
tools.description: Create a project todo. The UI-compatible fields are title, status, owner, priority, due_at and description.

tools.name: project_todo_delete
tools.description: Delete one project todo. Call only after the user explicitly asked to delete it and you have confirmed the todo id.

tools.name: project_todo_get
tools.description: Get one project todo by id, including title, status, owner, priority, dueAt, description and preserved original metadata.

tools.name: project_todo_list
tools.description: List project todos in board order. Optionally filter by todo/doing/done status or exact owner. Use this before updating or deleting a todo when you need its id.

tools.name: project_todo_summary
tools.description: Get an at-a-glance todo summary: total, status counts, high-priority, unassigned and dated todos. Use this before planning or assigning project todos.

tools.name: project_todo_update
tools.description: Patch one project todo. Omitted fields are preserved; pass null for owner, priority, due_at or description to clear that field.

tools.name: refine
tools.description: Refine (deepen / improve) an existing element's content. Returns a task_id immediately — poll get_task to read the result. Use this when the user wants more detail on a concept they already created.

target_richness.description: Target richness 1-5 (1=低档, 3=高档, 5=专家). Default 3.

direction.description: Optional direction, e.g. '补充失败案例' / '加入数学推导'

tools.name: release_improvement
tools.description: Release a previously-claimed improvement. Call after you finish or abandon work so other agents can pick it up if needed. agent_id must match the claimer; pass force=true to override (admin / unstick a crashed peer).

agent_id.description: Same id you used when claiming. Defaults to '<hostname>-mcp' if omitted.

force.description: Force-release regardless of who currently holds it. Use only when a peer agent has crashed and left the claim dangling.

tools.name: reorder_children
tools.description: Set the display order of direct children under a parent. `child_ids` is the desired order; any existing children not in the list are appended at the end in their original order.

tools.name: reparent_element
tools.description: Move `child_id` under a new parent (or detach to top-level by passing null).

tools.name: search_elements
tools.description: Substring + tag search across element titles, subtitles, and tags. Returns ranked matches. Use this to find candidates before deciding to attach / extend / refine.

tools.name: task_complete
tools.description: Mark a task done or undone. Equivalent to task_update with `done`, but clearer intent. Pass done=true to mark complete, done=false to un-complete. This is the single most common Hermes action — when 大斌哥 says '我做完了 X' you call this.

tools.name: task_create
tools.description: Create a task. If goalId is given it attaches to that goal (contributes to plan progress). If goalId is omitted the task is 'orphan' and won't move any plan needle — orphan is OK for ad-hoc todos, but for plan execution prefer attaching to a goal.

date.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Use today's date for 'do today'.

tools.name: task_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a task. Use sparingly — if 大斌哥 just doesn't want to do it today, prefer task_update to move it to a later date.

tools.name: task_list
tools.description: List tasks with optional filters. The most common Hermes use: task_list({ date: 'today' }) to see what 大斌哥 has on his plate today. Other filters: planId scopes to one plan, goalId to one goal's tasks, done=true|false to filter by completion. Returns each task with title/date/goalId/done.

date.description: ISO YYYY-MM-DD, or 'today' / 'overdue'. 'overdue' = date<today AND done=false. Omit for all dates.

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Patch fields on an existing task. Common: change `date` to reschedule, change `goalId` to re-attach to a different goal, change `title` to rename. To mark done/undone, prefer task_complete (clearer).

tools.name: update_element
tools.description: Patch an existing element. Only the fields you pass are written; omitted fields stay unchanged. Use this AFTER you've generated new content for an element — call get_element first to know what's there.

tools.name: update_improvement
tools.description: Update an existing improvement task. Typical transitions: (1) analyze requirement → fill `prd_content` and `tasks`; (2) user reviewed PRD/tasks → status='ready_to_develop'; (3) dev shipped fix → status='ready_to_verify'; (4) verification pass/fail → status='verified' or 'rejected' with verification_notes. ALWAYS list_improvements first to confirm the id.

verification_notes.description: When transitioning to verified/rejected: explain what you tested and the outcome. Stored in the audit trail.

tools.name: update_section
tools.description: Replace a single section inside an element's content. The element's other sections stay untouched. Use this for section-scoped refinement to avoid risk of wiping unrelated sections. Blocks must use Rich section block styles only. Supported block.style values: "attachments", "budget-table", "callout", "check-list", "checklist-grouped", "competitor-table", "day-schedule", "decision-list", "diagram", "dot-list", "example-list", "image", "image-placeholder", "kv-table", "lead", "markdown", "mechanism-flow", "mindmap-embed", "module-grid", "mvp-grid", "phase-timeline", "prose", "quote", "warn-cards". Never use style "list"; for bullet recommendations use {"style":"dot-list","items":["item: reason"]}, or use {"style":"markdown","text":"- **item**: reason"}.

blocks.description: New block payload for this section. Blocks must use Rich section block styles only. Supported block.style values: "attachments", "budget-table", "callout", "check-list", "checklist-grouped", "competitor-table", "day-schedule", "decision-list", "diagram", "dot-list", "example-list", "image", "image-placeholder", "kv-table", "lead", "markdown", "mechanism-flow", "mindmap-embed", "module-grid", "mvp-grid", "phase-timeline", "prose", "quote", "warn-cards". Never use style "list"; for bullet recommendations use {"style":"dot-list","items":["item: reason"]}, or use {"style":"markdown","text":"- **item**: reason"}.

tools.name: write_annotation
tools.description: Save an annotation (highlight / underline) with optional AI analysis. Returns the new annotation id.

tools.name: write_paths
tools.description: Replace ALL paths centered on `center_id`. Use this when regenerating; appendForCenter (via generate_paths) is the additive variant.

tools.name: write_qa
tools.description: Save a Q&A pair attached to an element. `anchor` lets the UI render it under a specific section or annotation.

tools.name: write_signal
tools.description: Append a signal record. Used to track AI op completion, user feedback, reverts, etc. — the Reviewer AI feeds on these.
